points: The people promised to listen, but as soon as Yirmiyahu said "stay in Eretz Yisrael," they called him a liar: "Sheker atah medaber."
No one in Tanach uses the word "sheker" (falsehood) more than Yirmiyahu, and now they turn it on him. It's the first time anyone calls him a liar.

They blame Baruch ben Neriah. The Abarbanel explains: Baruch hadn't received prophecy yet and supposedly wanted to stay in Eretz Yisrael to get it. When people want something, they'll believe any conspiracy theory.
According to the Abarbanel, this was right after Yom Kippur. We see how fast people drop the inspiration of the Yamim Noraim.
In Tachpanches, Yirmiyahu buries stones at Paroh's house: Nevuchadnetzar will come put his throne there and burn Egypt and its idols. Running away from Bavel won't help.
